text.en:
A member of Reserve Op Team A6. At her own request, she has transferred to become a Guard Operator, and has shown exceptional talent in close-quarters combat and the use of heavy melee weapons. In addition to A6's regular missions, she often participates in all manner of field missions that require venturing into dangerous areas in a personal capacity.
Everyone says that Catapult, who used to be so fond of slacking off and playing tricks, has completely changed. As for this assessment, she neither confirms nor denies it.
text.zh:
行动预备组A6成员，在本人意愿下变更为近卫干员，并展现出极强的近身搏斗和使用重型近战武器的天赋。在A6小队的日常任务之外，她也常以个人名义参与各种需要前往险地的外勤任务。
大家都说那个过去总是喜欢偷懒耍滑头的空爆完全变了，对于这种评价，她不置可否。

text.en:
Imaging tests show the indistinct outlines of internal organs, obscured by abnormal shadows. Originium granules detected in the circulatory system. The subject is confirmed to be infected with Oripathy.

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 5%
Operator Catapult displays clear symptoms of Oripathy.

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.33u/L
Due to frequent entry into high-risk environments and participation in high-intensity combat, Operator Catapult's condition is at risk of worsening.
text.zh:
造影检测结果显示，该干员体内脏器轮廓模糊，可见异常阴影，循环系统内源石颗粒检测异常，有矿石病感染迹象，现阶段可确认为矿石病感染者。

【体细胞与源石融合率】5%
干员空爆拥有明显的感染者症状。

【血液源石结晶密度】0.33u/L
由于频繁出入高危环境、参与高烈度的战斗，干员空爆的病情有恶化风险。

text.en:
Regarding the mission report on the trip to Houei, Orchid and Catapult each submitted their own version. Orchid's version was as meticulous as ever, allowing readers to clearly understand the whole story from beginning to end, while Catapult's left people both amused and helpless—
She submitted a report that, in her view, was extremely detailed, but its contents had to do only with hunting.
Yes, if you only read Catapult's mission report, you could never know what exactly she and Orchid encountered in Houei. However, after reading it, you would certainly know what sort of environment surrounds Houei, what kinds of monsters inhabit it, and whether or not those monsters can be eaten.
Even Orchid was surprised after reading it, curious about when Catapult had collected all this information. Catapult, with a look of pride, then listed them off for Orchid one by one, explaining what monsters certain Houei dishes had actually used as ingredients, what monster the meat they had eaten around a campfire on one occasion had come from, and so on. She also stated that Orchid had simply spent the entire time looking miserable and had not cared about such things at all.
It must be said that Catapult's material is undoubtedly worth zero points as a mission report, but as a regional gazetteer, it could be called full marks.
Moreover, the adventure the two of them had was simply far too bizarre. No matter how comprehensively Orchid wrote about it, some skepticism would be inevitable. Catapult's report dispelled those doubts quite well—anyone with a silver tongue can make up a story, but making up an entire ecosystem is truly not something just anyone can do.
text.zh:
关于泡影国之行的任务报告书，梓兰和空爆各自递交了一个版本，梓兰的版本一如既往地缜密，让人能够清晰地得知事情的来龙去脉，而空爆的则让人哭笑不得——
她提交了一份在她看来十分详细的报告，但内容却只和狩猎有关。
是的，只看空爆的任务报告，你绝不可能知道她和梓兰究竟在泡影国遭遇了什么，但是，看完之后，你一定会知道泡影国周边有什么样的环境，栖息着什么样的怪物，以及这些怪物能不能吃。
就连梓兰看过后都很惊讶，好奇空爆到底是在什么时候收集到这些情报的，空爆则一脸自豪地向梓兰一一列举，在泡影国吃的什么菜其实食材来自什么怪物，某一次在篝火旁吃的肉又来自什么怪物等等，并表示只是梓兰整天愁眉苦脸，根本没有关心这种事而已。
不得不说，空爆的这份材料，作为任务报告毫无疑问是零分，但作为风土志，可以说是满分。
而且，两人的这场冒险实在是太过光怪陆离，就算梓兰写得再事无巨细，也难免让人有所怀疑，而空爆的这份报告很好地打消了这些疑惑——编故事，口才好的都会编，但编完整的生态系统，那可真不是一般人能做得到的。

text.en:
When we get together, we often play competitive board games.
Who wins always follows a certain pattern—when everyone is still unfamiliar with the rules, Catapult wins more often, but once everyone has more or less figured them out, Spot or I start winning more.
And the more Catapult wins at first, the worse she loses later. On the one hand, this is because she is very good at using the rules to obstruct other people and win that way, meaning her victories are always built on the suffering of one or even several others, so she often ends up facing retaliation afterward—sometimes outside the game, such as when I assign her a little extra work. On the other hand, once that initial novelty wears off, she clearly loses interest in the game and is just playing along.
This is entirely in line with the general impression she gives: a short-lived enthusiasm, unwilling to spend too much time on anything. This sort of personality is hardly uncommon. In other words, it should be a trait shared by many children going through adolescence—full of energy, but unsure where to pour their passion.
As they grow older and gather more experience, most children either lose that energy or find something to devote their passion to. What makes Catapult unusual is that even at her age, she still retains both that energy and the frustration of not knowing what goal to set for herself... All right, truthfully, I don't think that is particularly unusual. If anything, many adults who pride themselves on being mature have simply lost the passion to explore and picked some random thing to call their goal.
As one such adult, I find Catapult's childish nature irritating most of the time, just like when we play board games. With many things, you can clearly tell she is capable of doing better, but she just refuses to, and often creates extra trouble for me because of it.
One could say the only effect time and experience have had on her is that she now knows very clearly what degree of responsibility she needs to bear for the things she does. When she tries to find some fun in something she has already grown bored of, she knows what sort of trouble she can keep under control, the sort that can be resolved with a few scoldings from me. In many cases, this makes her seem even more 'infuriating,' but, sigh, what am I supposed to do?
I say all this because I want to clarify one thing—after we returned from Sargon, quite a few of our colleagues felt that Catapult had changed, but from my point of view, Catapult has not changed at all.
Thank goodness. If that baffling trip to Houei contributed anything to Rhodes Island, then I am afraid it was only that Catapult finally found a toy she can't put down—and it seems she will not be losing her passion for it for a very long time.
—'Supplementary Records on the Houei Incident'
text.zh:
我们聚在一起的时候，经常会玩一些对抗类的桌游。
胜利的归属总是遵循一个规律——在大家还不熟悉规则的时候，总是空爆赢得比较多，等到大家都差不多摸清楚规则了，则是我或者斑点赢得多。
并且，空爆前面赢得越多，后面就输得越惨。一方面，这是因为她很擅长利用规则阻碍其他人，以此来获胜，她的胜利一定是建立在某人甚至某几人的痛苦之上的，所以之后她往往会遭到报复——有时候是场外的，比如我会给她布置一点额外的任务；另一方面，过了开头的新鲜劲后，她就明显失去了对游戏的兴趣，后面都只是陪玩。
这和她给人的一般印象完全一致，三分钟热度，对各种事情都不愿意花费太多时间。她这种性格并不算少见，换句话说，这应该是许多处于青春期的孩子都会有的特征——拥有充沛的活力，却不知道该将自己的热情倾注在什么地方。
随着年岁的增长和阅历的丰富，大多数孩子要么失去活力，要么找到倾注热情的对象，而空爆的特殊性在于，即使她已经到了这个岁数，还保持着活力和对于无法确定目标的烦恼……好吧，其实我觉得这没什么特殊的，不如说，自诩成熟的成年人们，很多时候也不过是失去了探索的热情，随便找了一件事当做自己的目标罢了。
作为这样的成年人之一，我大多数时候讨厌空爆这种孩子气的性格，就像我们玩桌游时那样，很多事你明显能感觉到她能做得更好，但她就是不愿意，还常常因此给我惹一些额外的麻烦。
可以说，时间和阅历在她身上起到的唯一作用，就是让她清楚地知道自己需要为自己在做的事承担什么程度的责任。当她想要从已经觉得无聊的事情中寻找一些乐趣时，她知道自己惹出什么样的麻烦是可控的，是只要被我骂两句就能收场的，这在许多时候会让她看起来更加“可恶”，但是，唉，我又能怎么办呢？
说这些，是因为我想澄清一件事——在我们从萨尔贡回来之后，不少同事觉得空爆发生了改变，但在我的视角看来，空爆其实没有发生任何变化。
谢天谢地，如果说这趟莫名其妙的泡影国之旅为罗德岛带来了什么贡献，那我觉得恐怕只有让空爆终于找到了她爱不释手的玩具这一件事——而且，看起来在很长一段时间里，她都不会对其丧失热情。
——《关于泡影国事件的额外留档》

text.en:
In the class change assessment report on Catapult submitted to the Doctor, Dobermann specifically noted Catapult's attitude toward combat. The relevant section is as follows:
I have met many warriors who enjoy combat itself, and Rhodes Island has no shortage of people like that. Their attitude toward combat is generally this: 'I hope to prove through combat that I am growing stronger. I am fighting myself. I want to keep surpassing myself.' For them, combat is a test.
At first, when I heard others mention Catapult's situation, I thought her personality had changed, and found it rather strange. It did not seem like her.
After testing her, I understood immediately. Her attitude... I have seen it before in certain people. What these people seek is not simply becoming stronger, but the thrill of standing on the razor's edge between life and death. Catapult is the same. She has no thoughts of challenging her own limits or holding a dialogue with herself. She simply thinks fighting enormous monsters is exciting enough to dispel the boredom in her heart.
Put that way, I can instead understand why she would undergo such a change.
What these two kinds of people have in common is that they both become stronger very quickly. The difference is that people like Catapult often do not live long.
The Felyne named Masamune seems to appreciate this quality of hers as a hunter, and I can understand that. In the context of nature, there is indeed nothing wrong with it—failing over and over, challenging again and again, growing stronger again and again, until they themselves become part of the law of the jungle.
Of course, I can also understand your concerns, Doctor. For people like this, all tempering exists only to pursue stronger stimulation, and the consequence of endlessly pursuing such stimulation is inevitably destructive.
However, I do not think you need to worry too much.
Compared to others of her 'kind,' Catapult is different in certain ways.
If I had to summarize it, I would say—she is not that single-minded. Catapult will never be able to devote everything she has to the hunt.
And the reason is obvious, is it not?
text.zh:
在递交给博士的有关空爆的转职评估报告中，杜宾特别提到了空爆对战斗的态度，内容如下：
我见过许多喜欢战斗本身的战士，罗德岛上也有不少这样的人，他们对于战斗的态度大体上都是——“我希望通过战斗证明自己正在变强，我正在和自己战斗，我想要不断超越自己。”战斗之于他们，是一种考验。
一开始，我听别人提起空爆的情况，以为她性格变了，还有些奇怪，觉得这不像她。
测试过后我立刻理解了，她的态度……我曾经在一些人身上见过，这类人追求的并不是单纯的变强，而是生死差之毫厘的刺激感。空爆也一样，她并没有什么挑战自我的极限、和自己对话之类的想法，她只是单纯觉得和巨大的怪物战斗够刺激，足够让她消遣心里的无聊。
这样说来，我反倒能够理解为何她会有这样的转变。
这两类人的共同点是他们都能很快地变强，而不同的是，空爆这类人往往很短命。
名叫政宗的艾露猫似乎很欣赏她这种属于猎人的特质，我能理解。这在自然这个语境中确实是没有问题的——不断地失败，不断地挑战，不断地变强，他们本身就成了丛林法则的一环。
当然，我也能理解你的担忧，博士。对这类人来说，一切的磨练都只是为了追求更强烈的刺激，而无限追求这种刺激的后果，必然是毁灭性的。
但是，我觉得你也不必太过担心。
和自己的“同类”相比，空爆又有一些不一样的地方。
如果要我概括的话，我觉得是——不纯粹。空爆永远无法做到把自己的一切投入到狩猎上。
而理由也显而易见，不是吗？

text.en:
Catapult soon made a name for herself in certain explorer and hunter circles, and many professional teams reached out to recruit her, but she turned them all down.
She had thought about this question before, because Orchid was always earnestly telling every member of Team A6 not to focus only on the present, but to think more about the future.
Clearly, this was exactly the sort of question Orchid wanted her to think about.
Every now and then—usually when she was bored out of her mind—she would ask herself: What do you want to do in the future?
Even more rarely, in order to respond to Orchid's expectant gaze, she would also try very hard to come up with an answer, but she found she really could not do it.
It seemed like she would never become the kind of person Orchid was, someone always prepared for the future.
But she did not think she could be called someone who lived in the moment either. After all, people like that were not as lazy as she was.
She skipped out on training, took a careless attitude toward missions, and aside from Team A6, had no real intention of maintaining any relationships.
Orchid was always criticizing her for drifting through life, and she thought so herself, too. But in truth, she knew it was just that she did not understand what any of those things were supposed to mean.
In a haze, she felt that she was waiting—waiting for something she could truly devote her energy to.
When she told Orchid about this conclusion, Orchid said, 'If you don't try, you'll never find what suits you.'
Now, she feels like she may have found it. She likes hunting, so finding a team dedicated to hunting seems like a better choice. She's sure that Orchid would absolutely support the idea—on the surface, at least.
But she is not as awkward about this as Orchid is. Orchid will not admit she likes Team A6, but Catapult is different.
She has never denied that she likes every member of Team A6. She likes their personalities, and she likes that one-of-a-kind atmosphere that only exists when they are all together.
Give that up? She would rather give up hunting.
Yes. So what troubles her is not whether she should leave Team A6 to pursue her own goals, but how she can convince the rest of Team A6 to join her in her hunting pursuits. Can't convince them? Then she'll just drag them along!
She has already come up with a few ideas. She can trick—no, convince Spot to draw a hunting comic with her. She will write the script, Spot will draw it, and then they will use the excellent story to lure Popukar in and get her to love hunting too. Midnight is a bit trickier... Wait, she's collected so many business cards. Surely getting him to do a little work in his own field wouldn't hurt. As for Orchid, well, if everyone else is going, Orchid will definitely come too!
That's right, it's decided!
She thought proudly that someday, she would hunt the greatest beast on this land! And when that time came, Team A6 would definitely be the greatest team on this land too! Probably!
text.zh:
空爆很快在一些探险家圈子和猎人圈子里有了名声，许多专业的团队也向她抛出橄榄枝，不过都被她拒绝了。
她考虑过这个问题，因为梓兰姐总是会苦口婆心地告诉A6小队的每一个人，不能只顾着当下，要多为未来想一想。
很显然，这就是梓兰姐要她想一想的问题。
偶尔地——大多数是闲得太无聊的时候，她也会问自己：你未来想做什么？
更加偶尔地，为了回应梓兰姐期待的眼神，她也很努力地想要得出一个答案，但她发现自己确实做不到。
她似乎永远也成不了梓兰姐那样为未来做好准备的人。
但她觉得自己也算不上享受当下的人，毕竟，那样的人可没有她这么懒散。
她逃避训练，对任务吊儿郎当，人际关系除了A6小队，也没有什么维持的想法。
梓兰姐总是批评她浑浑噩噩，她自己也觉得自己浑浑噩噩，但是，其实她知道，她只是不明白那些东西有什么意义。
朦胧之中，她觉得自己是在等待，等待一个真正能够让她投入精力的东西出现。
她把这个结论告诉梓兰姐，梓兰姐则会说：“你不去尝试，永远也找不到适合自己的东西。”
现在，她觉得自己似乎找到了。她喜欢狩猎，那找一个专门狩猎的团队似乎是一个更好的选择，她敢说，梓兰姐一定会支持这个想法——至少表面上支持。
但她不像梓兰姐那么别扭，梓兰姐不承认自己喜欢A6小队，她可不一样。
她从来不否认自己喜欢A6小队的每一个人，喜欢他们的个性，喜欢和他们在一起时才会产生的，那独一无二的空间。
要她放弃这个？那她情愿放弃狩猎。
是的，所以她烦恼的并不是应不应该为了自己的追求离开A6小队，而是，她要如何说服A6小队的其他人也加入她的狩猎事业——说服不了？那就把他们拖走！
她已经有了一些主意，她可以骗，哦不，说服斑点一起画一本狩猎漫画，她来写脚本，斑点来画，然后用优秀的情节吸引泡普卡上钩，让她也爱上狩猎。月见夜有点麻烦，对了，自己收了那么多名片，让他去做点本职工作也不是不行。至于梓兰姐，哎呀，大家都来的话，梓兰姐肯定也会来的！
没错，就这么决定了！
她得意地想着，总有一天，她要狩猎大地上最厉害的野兽！到时候，A6小队肯定也是这片大地上最厉害的小队！大概吧！

text.en:
Masamune's weapon guide provides detailed explanations of the moves for all manner of hunting weapons. These days, the blank spaces in the charge blade guide have been completely filled with Catapult's notes.
Of course, while they may be notes, most of them are not exactly serious business.
For example, next to 'Morphing Advance,' she has drawn a whole bunch of tally marks to keep track of how many times she failed to morph in time and crashed into a wall while using it.
Above 'Counter Peak Performance,' she wrote two lines in huge letters—'Don't forget to check your Wirebug before you use this! It can only block one attack! Don't rely on it too much!' She even drew a set of stick figures of herself getting sent flying by a monster after getting carried away.
The notes next to 'Axe Hopper' are even more absurd. There are some thoughts on combat techniques like attack placement, sure, but most of them are her trying to figure out which pose looks coolest when she uses a midair Super Amped Element Discharge, and it seems like she never did come up with an answer.
However, next to 'Condensed Spinning Slash,' she actually wrote down some serious thoughts—
Focusing your mind on a single instant, blocking your opponent's strongest blow, then countering with your own strongest Super Amped Element Discharge... That huge back-and-forth is exactly what the charge blade is all about.
But this move is really interesting too. You could say it changes the whole style of the charge blade. Instead of relying on instant defenses and powerful moves, it emphasizes instant reaction and finding chances to attack while avoiding the enemy's attacks. It even feels just like Popukar's chainsaw when you use it. What a shame I didn't get to use it back in Houei.
I still like the former better, but Condensed Spinning Slash has its own fun too. Hah, and Axe Hopper is a blast as well. The charge blade is even more interesting than I first imagined!
text.zh:
政宗带来的武器使用指南详细介绍了各种狩猎武器的招式。如今，盾斧的使用指南上，空白的部分已经完全被空爆的笔记填满。
当然，说是笔记，实际上大多也并不是什么很正经的内容。
比如在“变形前进”旁边，她画了很多竖线，来记自己用这招的时候来不及变形，撞了多少次墙。
而在“完全充能反击”这一招上方，她写了两行大字——“用的时候别忘了看看翔虫的状态！它只能抵挡一次攻击！不要太依赖它！”还画了一组自己因为得意忘形而被怪物掀飞的简笔画。
“击斧跳跃”这一招旁边的内容更是令人无语，虽然也有关于打点之类的战斗技巧的思考，但更多的是她在研究自己施放空中超高输出属性解放斩时什么样的姿势最帅，并且看起来直到最后也没有得出答案。
不过，在“高压回填斩”这招旁边，她倒是认认真真地写了一些自己的想法——
把精神集中在一个瞬间，防御住对方最强的一击，再用我最强的超高输出属性解放斩反击，这种大开大合的感觉正是盾斧的精髓。
但这一招也很有意思，可以说是改变了盾斧的流派——不依赖瞬间的防御和强力的招式，而是讲究临场反应，在躲避对方攻击的同时寻找攻击的机会，而且用起来的手感就跟泡普卡的电锯似的，在泡影国的时候没用上真是可惜了。
我还是更喜欢前者，但高压回填斩也有它的乐趣，哈，还有击斧跳跃也很好玩，盾斧这把武器真是比我一开始想象的还有意思！
